scope: Explicit CPU, memory and ephemeral-storage declarations for regular and init containers. The source check sees the raw manifest. Admission sees defaulted resource values. An upstream kubelet device plugin supplies exactly two synthetic device allocations without GPU hardware.

checks.claim: API admits an unbounded regular container before policy
API admits an unbounded init container before policy
Kubernetes copies limits to requests before validating admission
Source checker catches omitted requests for both container classes
checks.observed:
containers/regular missing requests.cpu
containers/regular missing requests.memory
containers/regular missing requests.ephemeral-storage
initContainers/initializer missing requests.cpu
initContainers/initializer missing requests.memory
initContainers/initializer missing requests.ephemeral-storage

checks.claim: A Pod with explicit declarations reaches Ready
One fixture node advertises exactly two synthetic device-plugin units
Kubernetes defaults the synthetic device request from its explicit limit
Native API validation rejects unequal extended-resource values
Before enforcing the enrollment rule, both fixture declaration gaps are admitted
The named conditional policy rejects both missing and wrong extended-resource keys
Separate running Pods see distinct files mounted by the kubelet Allocate response
The CPU-only control runs with no synthetic device mount
A third enrolled request remains unscheduled with the exact insufficient-device reason
